create_calibration_curve: create calibration curves using CalibrationDisplay.from_estimator to visualize predicted probability reliability
build_calibrated_classifier: build a CalibratedClassifierCV wrapper with isotonic or sigmoid method to improve classifier probability calibration
test_classifier_calibration: test classifier calibration quality with brier_score_loss, log_loss, roc_auc_score, precision, recall, and f1_score metrics
visualize_probability_histograms: visualize predicted probability distributions as histograms alongside calibration curves for multiple classifiers
compare_calibration_methods: compare naive bayes and linear SVC calibration using isotonic and sigmoid methods with reliability diagrams
